summary: Systems, automation, and technical operations leader with a career spanning financial services, medical devices, manufacturing, and software. At Western Union, Hospira, Volcano Corporation, and Philips, progressed from customer and systems support into engineering, validation, quality operations, product quality, and safety, quality, and regulatory leadership. Experienced in guiding cross-functional teams, improving product-lifecycle systems, supporting global hardware and software products, and integrating design controls, risk management, post-market surveillance, and operational continuity. Combines an MS in Information Management (4.0 GPA) and an Electrical Engineering degree with hands-on software and AI learning across Python, JavaScript, full-stack systems, machine learning, and RAG.
headline: Systems, Automation & Technical Operations
